# ghost/settings

Android Settings: privacy-bounded native model/build, battery, storage totals and Wi-Fi yes/no reads; switch dark theme.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/settings
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/settings get_device_info --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/settings get_battery_status --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/settings get_storage_usage --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/settings get_wifi_status --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/settings set_dark_theme --device <serial> --param enabled=<enabled>
```

## Actions

- `get_device_info`: What Android version is this phone running?
- `get_battery_status`: How much battery do I have left?
- `get_storage_usage`: How much storage is free on my phone?
- `get_wifi_status`: Is Wi-Fi enabled and connected?
- `set_dark_theme`: Turn on dark mode
